page.overview:
Who is Seraphax?

Seraphax was a Fallen Angel of the Dark Angels Legion and the Sorcerer Lord of the Ten Thousand Eyes warhost of Heretic Astartes that operated in the Imperium Nihilus region of the Ultima Segmentum. Like many of the Fallen, Seraphax did not believe himself to be a Traitor to the Emperor, but instead sought to ultimately use the power of Chaos as a means to better the lot of Humanity.

Seraphax was slain on the world of Sable by Lion El'Jonson after the Dark Angels primarch's awakening in the Era Indomitus. Drawn to Sable through the sub-realm of the Immaterium known as Mirror-Caliban by the Sorcerer Lord's machinations as part of an insane plan to use the primarch's undead body to overthrow the Chaos Gods, Seraphax was ultimately slain during his duel with the primarch as a mutated beast by his own lieutenant Baelor, who stabbed him through the back.

Baelor, also one of the Fallen, believed that Seraphax had finally been too corrupted by Chaos to save and also sought his primarch's forgiveness before the Lion granted him the Emperor's Peace.

Seraphax was originally a member of the garrison of the Dark Angels Legion left behind under the command of Luther on Caliban during the Horus Heresy to oversee the Legion's homeworld. When Caliban was destroyed at the end of the Heresy, Seraphax was one of the Fallen who was cast through time and space in the Immaterium as Caliban was destroyed by a great Warp storm.
